name: The Story of Pearl Girl
description: After narrowly escaping an abusive pearl farm, a young woman with unmatched talent carves out her own fate as treachery meets the world of jewelry.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Raised in torture and abuse, Duanwu risks her life every day harvesting pearls from the sea — but one daunting task offers her a slim chance of freedom.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Duanwu's performance dazzles the guests at the pearl auction. As she plots a path to a new life, a sudden turn of events exposes a buried secret.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In a state of panic, Cui Ding devises a plan to flee with his wealth. Meanwhile, Yan Zijing sees an opportunity to exact his revenge.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Duanwu sees an opportunity in discarded gemstone scraps. A heated encounter unfolds between her and Cui Shijiu at Yan Zijing's poetry contest.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: By helping Yan Zijing, Duanwu earns a chance to sell gemstone scraps in town. However, her first business venture quickly faces bitter setbacks.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A meeting further stokes Cui Shijiu's fury toward Yan Zijing. Hoping to make a sale, Duanwu resorts to a scheme that she later regrets.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: As a challenge from Cui Shijiu threatens Yan Zijing's business in Guangzhou, Duanwu steps up and confronts dangerous trials.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: While Duanwu's jewelry gains traction in the market, Zhang Jinran's investigation leads him to seek shelter in Yan Zijing's fleet.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A sudden surprise derails Duanwu's crucial business client meeting, leaving her and Yan Zijing scrambling to address the consequences.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: With Yan Zijing away, Duanwu must take the lead to protect the wealth of his fleet — especially the prized pearls set to be sold at auction.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: A scroll raises questions about the identity of Duanwu's birth father. To save her family, Cui Shijiu agrees to an arranged marriage.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: On his visit to a renowned jeweler, Yan Zijing notices something unusual about her. Meanwhile, a sinister conspiracy lurks within the Yue family.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: A brutal truth from Yue Yunxiu's dad leaves Yan Zijing devastated. Cui Shijiu, desperate to redeem herself, seeks help from a banished family member.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: As a mysterious ailment looms over the Cui family, Yan Zijing sets out on a journey to the west. Zhang Jinran has a heartfelt talk with Duanwu.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Cui Shijiu makes a devious move against Yan Zijing—a desperate act that triggers a treacherous fight for his priceless jewels.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Duanwu and Cui Shijiu seize a chance to escape. Meanwhile, Zhang Jinran visits Cui Ba to rescue Yan Zijing and his crew.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: While his bond with Duanwu grows deeper, Yan Zijing gets closer to the bandits who destroyed his family. Zhang Jinran visits a general for military aid.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: After racing to rescue a loved one in trouble, Yan Zijing faces a vicious ambush that could wipe out everything he's built.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Duanwu, wounded and distraught, tries to make sense of the deadly ambush. Taking shelter at a suspicious inn, she unexpectedly stumbles into a reunion.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: As Cui Shijiu hits rock bottom, her family also faces serious trouble. Meanwhile, Duanwu's search for Yan Zijing leads her to Yangzhou.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Hoping to promote her jewelry, Duanwu tries to approach Yangzhou's socialites and performers. But Yan Zijing is also vying for their attention.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Huan Lang receives a lucrative offer from Yan Zijing. Soon after, the competition heats up among Yangzhou's top performers.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Yangzhou's talent go all out to shine on a career-making stage, but some performances don't go as planned. Su Muzhe's risky bet pays off.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Cui Shijiu approaches Su Muzhe to form an alliance. Concerned about a damaged royal artifact, the Zheng family reluctantly turns to Yan Zijing for help.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Huan Lang receives an emotional plea from her ex-fiance. Su Muzhe's shop becomes the target of a shadowy conspiracy.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: A murder investigation leads Zhang Jinran to a shocking discovery. To prove her innocence, Su Muzhe must find a way to collaborate with Zheng Zhiheng.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: While Su Muzhe's fate hinges on the outcome of a public trial, Zhang Jinran and Yan Zijing are determined to help her through the crisis.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: An uninvited guest shows up at Huan Lang's funeral and sows discord, sparking an unprecedented crisis for Su Muzhe's business.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Zheng Zhiheng threatens to withdraw his investment from Su Muzhe's liquidated business. Yan Zijing faces another deadly trap.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Su Muzhe shows compassion to a wounded Yan Zijing. As her business struggles, Cui Shijiu scores a victory in her revenge plan.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Su Muzhe's new jewelry becomes an instant hit on the market, prompting her competitors to hatch a sabotage campaign.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Zhang Jinran interrogates Cui Shijiu over a suspicious discovery in her inventory. Xu Nanying plots a secret move from prison.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Su Muzhe's team reaches a breakthrough in manufacturing techniques. Meanwhile, Yangzhou's jewelry dealers battle to impress a discerning buyer.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Kang Ming's choice of supplier causes upheaval in the Yangzhou jewelry market. The Zheng family must tackle a shortage of essential materials.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Zhang Jinran faces numerous challenges in his investigation. As Zheng Zhiheng's life hangs in the balance, his father presents him with a tough choice.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: An esteemed guest sparks a design idea for Su Muzhe. In the meantime, Zheng Shiyuan vows to exact revenge for his son.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Zhang Jinran and Yan Zijing scramble to locate Su Muzhe. A startling revelation gives Yan Zijing a bitter dose of reality.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: A grieving Cui Shijiu plots her revenge against Zheng Shiyuan — a move that leads to a reconciliation with a longtime enemy.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Just as Zhang Jinran gets an opportunity to hold Yuchi Wuyi accountable, the poison afflicting Yan Zijing threatens to claim his life.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: With his lifelong dream fulfilled, Yan Zijing must face a harsh reality. Su Muzhe unveils a showstopper at a prestigious jewelry contest.
